title: Redshift connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Amazon Redshift instance's settings, read by the native analytics family (`loams_connector_analytics::redshift`, CN2 Task 17) over the Redshift Data API, signed with SigV4 (R17.4). Name exactly one of `cluster_identifier` and `workgroup_name`. `auth.*` hold secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`.

endpoint.description: The Data API endpoint; `https://redshift-data.<region>.amazonaws.com` when absent (a fixture replay names its proxy here).

db_user.description: A provisioned cluster's database user (temporary credentials).

secret_arn.description: A Secrets Manager ARN holding database credentials: an ARN, not a secret value.

access_key_id.description: The access key id. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

secret_access_key.description: The secret access key. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

session_token.description: A session token, for temporary credentials. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

s3.description: The bucket's endpoint and region when not AWS's own (the UNLOAD output and the sink's staging).

endpoint.description: An S3-compatible endpoint; AWS when absent.

allow_http.description: Allow plain HTTP to `endpoint`: development and CI stores only.

query.description: The source's query. Give it an `ORDER BY` for an exact resume (R17.9).

unload.description: The bulk path: `UNLOAD` the query to this location as Parquet and read each file as Arrow. Needs `query`.

iam_role.description: The IAM role ARN Redshift assumes for this location.

sink.description: The sink: each batch is staged as one Parquet file, then one `BatchExecuteStatement` (a transaction) copies it into a temporary table and appends or merges.

mode.description: `append` (INSERT … SELECT; at least once) or `merge` (MERGE on `keys`: an upsert, effectively once).

staging.description: Where each batch's Parquet file is staged for `COPY`; deleted after the load.

iam_role.description: The IAM role ARN Redshift assumes for this location.

statement_timeout_secs.description: How long a statement may run before the attempt is retried, in seconds.

lossy.description: Columns whose mapping loses information and is accepted (R5.1), for example a `timestamp` without a zone read as UTC.

evolution.description: The schema evolution policy (see the schema-mapping guide).
